reactFlash.instructions: MEMORIZE THE COLOR — CLICK THE RIGHT ONE BEFORE TIME RUNS OUT

escort.instructions: Mouse · WASD · Arrows to navigate — Click or Space to fire on enemy ships (destroying them clears the path, no combat triggered) — Survive {{duration}}s to deliver the passenger
escort.smoothTransit: The transit went by without major losses.
escort.tookTooManyHits: The ship took too many meteorite hits. The passenger didn't survive.

quickDraw.instructions: CLICK THE TARGET BEFORE IT DISAPPEARS

stopTheBar.instructions: STOP THE BAR IN THE GREEN ZONE

hint.mains: Stop the cursor at the center of the bar. At the edge you graze; at the center you hit hard.
hint.lame: A single fast pass. Dead center, the blade lands clean: up to ×1.6.
hint.tir: Three bullets, three cursors: fire on each pass. A fully perfect burst earns a bonus.
hint.precision: The cursor is slow, but only the golden line really counts: up to ×2.3, and almost nothing beside it.
hint.lourd: The cursor speeds up. The zone is wide and forgiving: this weapon hurts even when poorly aimed.
hint.explosif: The target isn't centered. The cursor bounces back and forth: let go before the fuse burns out.
